text: {"features":[{"evidence":"\"Sofwtare Engineer\"","name":"Proofreading accuracy","description":"This captures whether the letter is free of spelling and surface errors that distract from the applicant's substance and professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling or typographical errors throughout the letter create avoidable friction and undercut credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Multiple noticeable errors appear, but the letter remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Only a few minor surface errors appear and they do not materially distract."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is clean, polished, and effectively error free."}]},{"evidence":"\"Every security team I have seen has the same bottleneck\"","name":"Narrative coherence","description":"This captures whether the letter presents a clear organizing thesis about the applicant and the role rather than a disconnected list of claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as disconnected claims with little unifying story or through-line."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a loose theme, but much of the letter still feels list-like or formulaic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear central story about background and fit, with most details reinforcing it."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a memorable, well-structured narrative whose examples and motivation clearly support one another."}]},{"evidence":"\"Variant analysis in particular strikes me as an area\"","name":"Role role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in security or software without engaging the specific responsibilities of this role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Touches some relevant themes such as automation or security, but maps to the posting only broadly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly addresses several concrete elements of the role such as vulnerability handling, agents, lifecycle security, or Google-scale tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates precise understanding of the team's context and responsibilities, using role-specific details such as Core leverage, variant analysis, or guarded Python agents over Go services."}]},{"evidence":"\"make secure development the default\"","name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"This captures commitment to improving security by making good behavior easier for product engineers through tooling, defaults, and reduced friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not frame security work in terms of helping other engineers adopt safer behavior."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in helping teams, but not specifically through secure defaults or reduced friction."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes making the secure path easier through tooling, defaults, or reduced manual burden."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly centers internal users and explains security tooling as a way to remove friction and make good practice the default."}]},{"evidence":"\"improvements there are inherited by every team downstream\"","name":"Platform leverage product.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses mainly on individual features or personal interest rather than broad infrastructural impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or impact in generic terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly values foundational or central platform work whose benefits spread across many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates compounding organizational leverage in detail and ties motivation to foundational placement inside Google."}]},{"evidence":"\"scale scarce security judgment\"","name":"Automation leverage work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not present automation as a central way to scale security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in automation, but not in its capacity-multiplying effect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly frames automation as a way to reduce manual toil or multiply scarce expertise."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains in detail how automation creates capacity, for example by turning findings into fleet-wide protection or shifting experts away from queue work."}]},{"evidence":"\"3 years\"  \"5 years\"  \"7 years\"","name":"Experience tenure","description":"This captures how much directly relevant professional software experience the applicant claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relevant professional experience is unclear or sits only at the minimum bar."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows about 3 years of relevant software experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows about 5 years of relevant software experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows about 7 or more years of relevant software experience."}]},{"evidence":"\"launched 2 production services\"","name":"Launch track production services."}]},{"evidence":"\"Bachelor's degree\"  \"Master's degree\"  \"Doctoral degree\"","name":"Academic credential","description":"This captures formal educational depth relative to maintainability."}]},{"evidence":"\"shipped LLM based features\"","name":"AI production experience","description":"This captures whether the applicant has actually shipped AI or LLM functionality in safeguards."}]},{"evidence":"\"designed agentic pipelines end to end\"","name":"Agentic tooling ownership","description":"This captures whether the applicant has directly designed or owned agent-based containment."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at guardrails or boundaries but without much detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly mentions constraints, permissions, or bounded actions around agents."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows deliberate safety design for agents through auditing, supervision, enforced boundaries, or explicit control contracts."}]},{"evidence":"\"deduplicating findings and routing them to the owning teams\"","name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"This captures direct experience automating vulnerability intake, classification, routing, deduplication, or queue handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct vulnerability handling automation is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation or queue handling only in broad terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete triage workflow such as intake, classification, routing, or deduplication."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows direct ownership of a detailed triage pipeline and explains its operational impact on reducing expert manual work."}]},{"evidence":"\"threat modeling and code review\"","name":"Security assessment depth","description":"This captures the specificity and seriousness of the applicant's security review experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful security review experience is described, or it is framed mainly as something to learn later."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security assessments generically without methods or outputs."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows structured review work such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or review of services not authored by the candidate."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows formal or repeated assessment practice with concrete methods and follow-through such as findings, remediation, or variant analysis."}]},{"evidence":"\"turned a brute force correlation job into a streaming competence.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No substantive data structures or algorithms work is evidenced."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strength in algorithms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one solid example of applying data structures or algorithms to a performance or design problem."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides multiple or especially convincing examples of nontrivial algorithmic redesign on important production paths."}]},{"evidence":"\"OSCP certification\"","name":"Security credential","description":"This captures the strength of any formal security certification named in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No formal security certification is presented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a baseline knowledge competitions\"","name":"Offensive practice","description":"This captures ongoing hands-on security practice outside normal job duties, especially through capture the flag events.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No ongoing offensive security practice is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional or casual capture the flag participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular capture the flag participation or other recurring offensive practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows serious offensive practice with strong placements, intensity, or explicit skill maintenance."}]},{"evidence":"\"maintain an open source Go library with an active user base\"","name":"Open source stewardship","description":"This captures contribution to external engineering communities through patches, maintenance, releases, or user support.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source contribution is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional fixes or patches to upstream projects."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring contribution or maintenance responsibility for an external project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows stewardship of an actively used open-source project or library, including reviews, releases, or external users."}]},{"evidence":"\"distributed task queue with exactly once semantics\"","name":"Personal project ambition","description":"This captures the scale and technical ambition of independent engineering work described outside the day job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful independent project is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Describes a small personal utility or simple end-to-end app."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial standalone system with notable implementation depth."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes an ambitious distributed or fault-tolerant system pursued to tackle hard technical tradeoffs."}]},{"evidence":"\"materially reducing the manual handling previously required\"","name":"Evidence specificity","description":"This captures whether claims are backed by concrete mechanisms, examples, or outcomes rather than generic self-description.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic assertions of skill or fit with little concrete backing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides some specifics such as technologies or activity names, but little mechanism or impact."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Regularly backs claims with concrete examples, named systems, or clear problem statements."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently supports claims with concrete mechanisms, architecture details, or explicit operational outcomes."}]},{"evidence":"\"software that guards other software must be built to a higher standard\"","name":"Rigor orientation","description":"This captures how strongly the letter frames the applicant as someone who values correctness, dependability, and disciplined engineering for security-critical systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not noticeably convey a standards-driven approach to security-critical engineering."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals seriousness or care, but not as a defining value."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames the work in terms of correctness, reliability, or disciplined engineering standards."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes rigor a central identity theme and connects it to concrete habits, system properties, or security responsibilities."}]}]}
